main.description: Draft 3 court filings required before post-judgment enforcement: 執行文付与申請書 (civil exec act §26), 送達証明申請書 (civil proc rule §47), 判決確定証明申請書 (§48). Reads judgment PDF from B2, extracts parties/amounts/dates, fills templates/moushitate/{01,02,03}.md, writes .docx/.pdf to B2 legal-cases/{caseCode}/filings/.

caseCode.description: Kebab case case_code (e.g. commons-ag-litigation). Matches vertex_business_case.case_code.

kinds.description: Which of the 3 filings to draft. Typically all 3 together for one-trip court visit.

judgmentR2Key.description: B2 object key of judgment PDF. If omitted, looked up from vertex_business_case.judgment_r2_key.

creditorAddress.description: Override creditor (申立人) address. Defaults to case owner org address.

filingDate.description: Date on filing header. Defaults to today.

returnAddress.description: Return address for mailed original. Defaults to creditor address.

checklistUri.description: Submission checklist (印紙 / 郵券 / 添付書類)

totalRevenueStampJpy.description: 合計 収入印紙費 (300 + 150 + 150 = 600 JPY for full set)

errors.name: OcrExtractionFailed
errors.description: 判決 PDF から当事者・金額・日付を抽出できない

errors.name: CaseNotConfirmed
errors.description: vertex_business_case.confirmed_date が未設定 — 確定前は 3 書類発行不可
